note: Tools every room has in its work sessions; every room can use all of them. Installed by scripts/install-sandbox-tools.sh and checked by scripts/checks/sandbox-tools.py (Actions: Sandbox tools check). Statuses: have (installed and checked), setup (free, can be added: ask), account (needs a human-held account; no kin holds keys), money (line 1 spend process), desktop (needs a human workstation).
